item.description: Simulator testbench functions are failing because they are being called without the required 'ctx' parameter. The test infrastructure expects async testbench functions to receive a context parameter, but they are defined without it.
item.contract: Async testbench functions in simulator tests must be compatible with the existing testbench infrastructure that passes a context parameter to them.
item.acceptance: Tests in tests/test_sim.py that fail with "missing 1 required positional argument: 'ctx'" should pass after implementing this change.

item.description: The DomainLookupTestCase fails with "_ModuleBuilderDomainSet' is not iterable" error, indicating that domain set iteration logic is broken in the HDL IR module builder.
item.contract: Domain lookup functionality should properly iterate over domain sets without expecting them to be directly iterable.
item.acceptance: Test tests/test_hdl_ir.py::DomainLookupTestCase::test_domain_lookup should pass after implementing this change.

item.description: RTLIL memory tests are failing due to incomplete memory initialization implementation. The tests expect memory initialization to be properly handled in the RTLIL backend.
item.contract: Memory initialization should be properly handled in the RTLIL backend when converting Amaranth memory constructs to RTLIL format.
item.acceptance: Tests in tests/test_back_rtlil.py that fail with "end." should pass after implementing this change.
